description: With the API key that made the request: its receipt, with the usage, the price sheet version, the cost and, once settled, the settlement, its transaction and the rows behind the onchain digest. With no key: the public receipt of any request id, x402 ones included, with its line in the usage log, the payment, the settlement and where its proof is (GET /x402/v1/receipts/{id}).

request_id.description: The id returned with the completion (also the x-request-id header)
